name: Word Shuffle
description: Shuffles the word order, settling over time.
legacyScript: function animate(env,el,p){ var w=el.text.split(" "),L=w.length,n=Math.round(L*env.time),o=[]; for(var i=0;i<L;i++){ if(i<n)o.push(w[i]); else { var r=(AM.simplexNoise(i*4.0+env.absTime*8.0,0,p.seed)+1)/2; o.push(w[Math.floor(r*L)%L]); } } el.text=o.join(" "); return el; }
